_comment: The ONLY place a location is defined. Project front matter references these by slug, so a town name is typed once and feeds the rendered tag, the JSON-LD contentLocation, the sitemap, and any future location page or facet. No lat/lng here on purpose: inventing coordinates would publish false geo data. Add them from an authoritative source if geo schema is ever wanted.
_inServiceAreaComment: `inServiceArea` is measured against the areaServed claim in business.json. Today 4 of 7 portfolio towns are false, which is the geographic-signal inconsistency flagged in the plan. This flag is what gates which location pages may be built.
